Paragraph:
Translation: Regulated activities are prescribed in the Vedas, and the Vedas are directly manifested from the Supreme Personality of Godhead. Consequently the all-pervading Transcendence is eternally situated in acts of sacrifice.

Purport (Excerpt): ...If we have to work for the satisfaction of the yajna-purusa, Visnu, then we must find out the direction of work in Brahman, or the transcendental Vedas. The Vedas are therefore codes of working directions... After creating or impregnating the conditioned souls... He gave His directions in the Vedic wisdom as to how such conditioned souls can return home...
Situation/Problem_Faced: Knowing where to find authoritative guidance for action in a chaotic world.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Krishna traces the origin of duty back to the Vedas, which originate directly from the Supreme. Because sacrificial work connects directly to the divine source, the all-pervading Transcendence (Brahman) is eternally present in selfless acts of sacrifice.
Outcome/Resolution: Arjuna learns that performing sacrificial duty directly grounds human action in divine reality.

Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Anchoring in Wisdom: Relying on proven, time-tested principles for decision-making
Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Structural Guidance: Using structured codes of conduct to reduce anxiety and ambiguity
Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Transcendental Purpose: Infusing ordinary work with divine and enduring significance

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Brahma aksara-samudbhavam (The Vedas originating from the imperishable Supreme)
Sarva-gatam brahma (The all-pervading divine truth present in sacrifice)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Prescribed duties originate in the Vedas, which stem directly from the Supreme. Thus, the divine presence is inherently woven into every act of selfless sacrifice, connecting human effort to ultimate spiritual truth.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Navigating life without reliable guidelines breeds uncertainty. Rooting your actions in clear values and structured wisdom acts as a psychological anchor, protecting you from existential doubt and infusing routine tasks with higher meaning.
